notes: Stories refined for clearer contract boundaries and enforcement scope; no new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define configuration schema for multi-cluster MongoDB routing including cluster identifiers, environment mapping (dev/qa/prod), read/write roles, routing rules, and validation constraints (required fields, allowed values).

Add enforcement layer to validate that all MongoDB access requests go through the routing logic, reject direct or misrouted connections, and expose a controlled internal API (factory/get_client pattern) for governed access.

Integrate multi-cluster routing into existing services (provider search, embeddings, debug logger, pipelines) ensuring all MongoDB calls are refactored to use governed connection APIs with no bypass paths.

stories.title: Cluster Routing Configuration Schema
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multi-cluster MongoDB routing including cluster identifiers, environment mapping (dev/qa/prod), read/write roles, routing rules, and validation constraints (required fields, allowed values).

stories.title: Core Cluster Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to resolve and route MongoDB connections to the correct cluster based on operation type (read/write), environment, and service context. Ensure no cross-cluster contamination.

stories.title: Connection Governance Enforcement and Internal API Interface
stories.description: Add enforcement layer to validate that all MongoDB access requests go through the routing logic, reject direct or misrouted connections, and expose a controlled internal API (factory/get_client pattern) for governed access.

stories.title: Integration with Existing Services
stories.description: Integrate multi-cluster routing into existing services (provider search, embeddings, debug logger, pipelines) ensuring all MongoDB calls are refactored to use governed connection APIs with no bypass paths.

stories.title: Routing Validation and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests to verify correct cluster routing, prevention of cross-cluster access, environment isolation, and failure handling when clusters are unavailable.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce single governed access path and add integration tests for all services
